outcome: presence and relative ratios of different FN-fibrin complexes
cohort: 49 mothers who delivered healthy newborns at term (25 vaginal births, 24 cesarean sections) and 31 non-pregnant women
finding: FN concentration was higher in puerperal plasma after both vaginal birth and C-section compared to non-pregnant women, while cord plasma FN was lower after C-section; FN-fibrin complexes were elevated in both puerperal and cord plasma regardless of delivery mode.
